turns.text: Thanks for calling support, I understand you're seeing an unexpected charge on your account. Can you tell me more?
Yes, I was charged twice this month for the same subscription plan, and I only have one active account.
I'm sorry about that. Let me pull up your billing history and take a look at what happened.
I really need this resolved quickly because the double charge overdrew my account and caused a bank fee.
I completely understand, and I'll make sure we fix both the duplicate charge and reimburse the bank fee if it was caused by our error.
Looking at the history, it seems a billing retry job ran twice due to a temporary system issue on our end.
So this is a known bug, not something I did wrong on my side?
Correct, this is an internal billing system issue, not anything related to your account settings.
I'm processing a refund for the duplicate charge right now, and it should appear back in your account within three to five business days.
Thank you, that's a relief. Can you also send me an email confirming the refund and the reason for the double charge?
Absolutely, I'll send that confirmation email as soon as we hang up, along with a case number for your records.
I appreciate that. What about the bank fee, will that also be reimbursed automatically?
For the bank fee, please forward us the fee notice from your bank and we'll issue a separate reimbursement for that amount.
Okay, I'll send that over today. Is there anything I need to do to prevent this from happening again next month?
No action needed on your side, our engineering team has already disabled the faulty retry job that caused the duplicate billing.
That's good to hear. Thank you for explaining everything so clearly.
You're very welcome, and again I apologize for the inconvenience caused by the duplicate charge.
